protocol.sample_design: one deterministic, non-nested sample per instance/fraction; reused across both caps and all repeats
protocol.warning_rule: execution_error/timeout OR positive nanny termination/spill/paused samples/observed restarts; quality issues yield unknown
protocol.quiet_rule: success with complete clean diagnostics, conditions and telemetry, and all declared warning signals zero
protocol.selection_rule: per fraction, among configs with three quiet repeats choose lowest median probe lifecycle times balanced target-allocation weight; tie by config id; fallback to high-memory config if none eligible
protocol.comparison_unit: instance/target-cap/fraction group; do not pair separate-session repeats or treat repeat rows as independent workloads
protocol.stage_gate: Stop after 96 attempts for review; no automatic Stage C, training or main merge

reference.scope: historical full-input outcomes; same data and recorded environment; not fresh online executions
